segments.sensitive: Reviewers describing mildly sensitive or sensitive skin report the mask did not irritate, dry out, or trigger breakouts, and calmed redness.
segments.mature: A 61-year-old long-term user and a 40-year-old reviewer both credit the Proactiv line, including this mask, with keeping their skin looking younger.

concerns.aging: A 61-year-old and a 40-year-old reviewer say the product keeps their skin looking younger; neither reports negative age-related effects.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers describe the mask as hydrating and not drying, including one with sensitive skin who noted it didn't dry her skin out.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with mildly sensitive skin reports the mask calmed cheek redness and did not irritate her skin; turmeric root extract is cited by several as a soothing, anti-redness ingredient.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report visible fading of dark spots, hyperpigmentation, and acne scars within a week or two of use; one reviewer without dark spots could not evaluate this effect.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers using it against acne and clogged pores report it helps keep acne away, clears pores, and fades acne scars; one reviewer worried about breakouts due to sensitive skin found it did not cause any.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer notes the mask is not greasy on skin and rinses off cleanly, but no reviewer discusses oil control as an ongoing effect.

extraits.texte: This is one of those products that doesn't feel super strong while it's on, but after using it a few times, I noticed my skin looked smoother and more even. The redness I experience on my cheeks has seemingly calmed which I am particularly grateful for. The texture is creamy and easy to apply, and the applicator it comes with actually makes a difference because it keeps things clean and helps spread the mask evenly. It doesn't feel greasy, it rinses off easily, and it didn't irritate my mildly sensitive skin, which is a huge plus. I've been using it a couple times a week at night, and I always make sure to wear sunscreen the next day since it can make your skin more sensitive to the sun. It's simple, no fuss, and it's actually doing what it says it will. I received this complimentary from proactiv.
